description: This file contains helper methods related to rendering back-ends in the ANGLE graphics library, including functions for copying and manipulating pixel data, managing incomplete textures, and handling matrix uniforms and sample positions.

classes.name: IncompleteTextureSet
classes.description: Manages incomplete textures used as placeholders in the rendering context.

classes.name: PackPixelsParams
classes.description: Parameters for packing pixel data during readback operations.

classes.name: SetFloatUniformMatrixGLSL
classes.description: Template struct for setting GLSL uniform matrices.

classes.name: SetFloatUniformMatrixHLSL
classes.description: Template struct for setting HLSL uniform matrices.

methods.name: CopyImageCHROMIUM
methods.description: Copies image data between source and destination buffers with format conversions and flipping.

methods.name: getIncompleteTexture
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an incomplete texture placeholder.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes setting of uniform matrices for GLSL or HLSL shaders.
